story: Sophie and her friend Mia are in the park. [emotion:QT/surprised] Sophie sees a big pink kite stuck in a tall tree. Mia has a long stick and Sophie has a blue ribbon. Sophie and Mia work together and the kite comes down. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie feels happy and Mia feels happy too.
